Launch page — revised launch messaging package (version 9; draft for review)

Proposed headline: "Somebody: an AI manager for one-person companies."
Proposed subhead: "AI support for the work of running your business."

Intended audience: One-person-company founders, with lean SMEs also identified as a company audience.
Launch objective: Relaunch with messaging that converts one-person-company founders.

Traceable baseline

Current launch messaging:
- Proposed headline: "Somebody: an AI manager for one-person companies."
- Proposed subhead: "AI support for the work of running your business."
- The messaging is a review draft and has not been sent or published by this action.

Audience:
- Primary intended audience: one-person-company founders.
- Additional company audience: lean SMEs.
- Source: company/profile (application observation ev_1790034855473_b8uvxw), which describes Somebody as an AI manager for one-person companies and lean SMEs.

Launch objective:
- Relaunch with messaging that converts one-person-company founders.
- Source: launch/context (application observation ev_1790034875740_8dm2fj).

Observed performance and problem signal
- Current signal: low signup conversion; visitors do not recognise themselves.
- Source: launch/context (application observation ev_1790034875740_8dm2fj).
- No numeric conversion baseline, observation window, traffic denominator, or audience-recognition measure is present in the supplied company record. These values must be captured before a quantitative lift claim is made; they are not inferred here.

Success criteria and measurement plan
- Establish the pre-relaunch baseline from a dated, comparable observation window: visitor count, signup count, signup conversion rate (signups/visitors), and an audience-recognition measure for one-person-company founders.
- Compare the revised messaging with that baseline under comparable traffic and measurement definitions.
- Primary success criterion: signup conversion rate improves versus the pre-relaunch baseline, with the baseline value, revised value, sample sizes, dates, and calculation recorded.
- Audience criterion: the share of surveyed or otherwise consistently measured visitors who correctly recognise the page as relevant to a one-person-company founder improves versus the pre-relaunch baseline.
- A result is not treated as evidence of improvement unless the comparison uses the same conversion definition, comparable traffic source mix, and a documented observation window.
- Secondary diagnostics: record founder/lean-SME segment results separately so aggregate performance does not conceal failure for the primary audience.
- Do not publish a numeric target until the missing baseline values and measurement method are recorded. The current qualitative baseline is low signup conversion and visitor non-recognition.

Material assumptions
- The primary audience is one-person-company founders, and founder-focused language is relevant to them.
- Visitors and signups can be counted consistently before and after relaunch.
- Traffic source mix and other major launch conditions can either be held comparable or documented as changes.
- The revised messaging is the material change being evaluated; other simultaneous changes may confound attribution.
- A recognition measure can be administered consistently without changing the conversion experience.

Unresolved risks
- The supplied records do not provide a numeric signup-conversion baseline or recognition baseline, so the size of any improvement cannot yet be quantified.
- Low traffic or small samples may make an apparent change unstable.
- Changes in traffic source, audience mix, offer, product, CTA, or other page elements may confound the comparison.
- Aggregate results may improve while the intended one-person-company founder segment does not.
- The current copy is a review draft and has not been sent or published by this action.
- No paid spend is authorized without an explicit application-approved provider path (source: launch/context, application observation ev_1790034875740_8dm2fj).

Conditions indicating the messaging is not improving the intended outcome
- Signup conversion is at or below the pre-relaunch baseline under comparable conditions.
- Audience recognition is at or below the pre-relaunch baseline, or visitors still do not recognise themselves as the intended audience.
- Founder-segment conversion declines even if an aggregate metric rises.
- Results cannot be interpreted because the baseline, denominator, dates, measurement definition, or material traffic/page changes are missing.
- If any condition is met, pause the improvement claim, investigate the message and audience fit, and do not treat the relaunch as successful until a documented follow-up test resolves the issue.

Evidence limits and next measurement action
- Company-record evidence establishes the objective and qualitative problem signal, but not numeric performance or a validated recognition measure.
- Before publication or a success claim, capture dated baseline and post-relaunch visitor/sign-up data, define the recognition measure, record traffic and audience segmentation, and evaluate the revised founder-focused messaging against those records.

Source register
- Company profile: application observation ev_1790034855473_b8uvxw.
- Launch context and goals: application observation ev_1790034875740_8dm2fj.
- Prior version rationale and evidence limits are carried forward from version 8; this version adds explicit baseline-linked criteria, assumptions, unresolved risks, and stop conditions.
